rationale: Builds directly on the 9x512 reverse-tail recurrent baseline, but stops spending early 600s-run updates on the hardest recurrent path. The recurrent tail is now linearly warmed in over the first 22% of training via a compile-stable scalar in model state, then forced back to 1.0 before save/final eval so the scored int8+zlib path is unchanged at export time. This is a real structural edit aimed at recurrence scheduling, one of the still-open local categories, while keeping the file lean and preserving all required final metrics/log lines.
title: Tail Recurrence Warmup Curriculum
